description: AI-powered outreach engine: crawl a website, build audiences, find contacts, draft emails, and send after review.

summary.one_liner: A local, open-source outbound pipeline that crawls a website or reads a resume, finds target companies and contacts, drafts emails, and only sends after you approve them.
use_cases: Finding first customers for a product from its website
Reaching out to investors when raising money
Contacting hiring teams during a job search
Building a contact list of decision makers at target companies
Drafting and reviewing cold emails before sending
Running a low-cost outbound loop without a sales seat license
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd ai-outreach-engine
cp .env.example server/.env and add API keys
bun run --cwd server migrate (optional; also runs on server start)
notable: Three playbooks (find customers, reach investors, find jobs) on one shared pipeline
Contact-finding waterfall that scrapes domain emails, searches for people, guesses address patterns, and verifies before drafting
Learns which email formats worked for each domain and stores them in SQLite to reduce verification spend
Dry-run by default with an approval gate, suppressions, send window, and daily cap
Runs locally with the database on disk; no seat license or hosted CRM
caveats: Requires multiple paid or credit-based API keys (OpenAI, Firecrawl, Serper, Reoon, and Brevo or Gmail); OpenAI is the main variable cost
Reoon free tier is small (20 credits/day), so real prospecting needs a paid plan of about $9.95/month per the README
Sending through Brevo needs a verified sender domain (SPF/DKIM); Gmail needs an App Password and shows your Gmail address as the sender
No reply tracking yet; replies are handled in your own inbox
